So that is where, if I may say so, the market is reshuffled, and that is where we clearly with our now 8,000 IFAs, which have this entrepreneurial mindset, will certainly have some opportunities to seize.

kpis.nom_fr: Debut de la reforme allemande des retraites
kpis.citation: I think what I could say is if you look at everything that the German government says, there will be the start of this new pension reform on January 1st, 2027.
